claim: Southern Vietnam shifts into rainy season in June with the year's highest rainfall, typically heavy but short mid-afternoon downpours.
quote: June, July & August receive the highest rainfall of the year, though rainfall is generally heavy but short lasting, often occurring in a mid-afternoon heavy downpour.

claim: Nha Trang has the shortest coastal rainy season; in June it has calm seas, ~28-29C water and good visibility.
quote: Nha Trang beaches have calm seas, warm water (around 28C to 29C), and good visibility.

claim: Phu Quoc in June is full monsoon: rough seas and reduced visibility make snorkelling/diving less enjoyable and island ferries can be disrupted.
quote: June marks the start of rough seas and unpredictable storms, with strong waves and reduced underwater visibility making snorkeling and diving less enjoyable, and ferry services to smaller islands can be disrupted

claim: Cai Rang floating market is best 05:30-07:00, peak 4-6 AM, reached by boat from Can Tho's Ninh Kieu pier.
quote: the market is best around 6am to 7am ... peak activity from 4-6 AM

claim: The Hon Thom cable car off Phu Quoc is the world's longest 3-wire over-sea cable car at 7,899.9m.
quote: the world's longest 3-wire cable car over the sea (7,899.9m)

claim: A O Show is Lune Production's Vietnamese bamboo circus performed at the historic Saigon Opera House.
quote: Must-see cultural show in Ho Chi Minh ... Vietnamese Bamboo Circus ... Performance Venue: Saigon Opera House
